description: Localisations des Points de Mutualisation Fibre (PMZ) dans OpenStreetMap is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by magellium. Daily extract of Fibre Pooling Points (PMZ) in metropolitan France present in the OpenStreetMap open and collaborative database (OSM) [1]. Coverage: magellium. The portal shows the English title as "Locations of Fibre Pooling Points (PMZ) in OpenStreetMap" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is magellium. Its keywords include telecoms, fibre, telecommunication, wfs, fibres, telecom. The listing shows 5 download or service links in KML, SHAPEFILE, WFS, CSV. The listing shows 2024-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
